notes: Fastned "Gravity 123 kWh (2026+)" curve, 400 kW class, 12-87 % only, peak 405.6 kW at 12 % (1.4 % over the 400 kW rating). Conflicts with InsideEVs (Moloughney, 2025, EVgo 350 kW, depleted start): peak 375 kW, over 300 kW until almost 40 % and over 200 kW to nearly 50 %, whereas Fastned is under 300 kW from 26 % and 255 kW at 40 %. The same car on a 250 kW Tesla Supercharger (400 V) peaked ~210-220 kW and held 200+ kW to 42 %. Treat the Fastned curve as conservative above 25 %. Covered range 12-87 % only: 0-12 % and 87-100 % are not measured (the viewer holds the end values, which would show ~405 kW at 0 % and ~77 kW at 100 %). Fastned labels this entry "2026+", so the 2025 Grand Touring is an assumption. Only the 123 kWh gross pack is known (usable unknown), and the Dream Edition has different motors from the Grand Touring; the Fastned page does not distinguish them. No second source agrees with the shape.
